# The repair cafe cancellation list

Three people cancelled and the replacements arrived together. A waiting list is not a schedule unless someone can decline the offered slot. Give a time range and an easy way to say no. [[Repair ideas]]: the waiting time starts when a person rearranges the day, not when they reach our front door.
